facts.name: Paul L. Militello
facts.assignment: County criminal and criminal traffic under S-2025-58-A effective June1,2026; profile retains civil operating instructions, preserved without asserting current general civil assignment.

contact.contact_note: Header and repeated scheduling text use circuit5.org; one fallback paragraph uses circuit.org. Preserve discrepancy, do not infer tested delivery. Shared office telephone.

hearing_scheduling.summary: Email assistant filed motion and total hearing time. Retained civil section directs checking any case motion-practice order before requesting oral hearing.

proposed_orders.summary: After clerk confirms supporting documents docketed, submit Word proposed orders via portal with required codes or email without portal codes and with blank signature/date space. Correct and resubmit rejected orders; follow linked formatting instructions.

remote_appearances.summary: Criminal hearings in person, no virtual appearance. Retained civil section permits Zoom or in person and requires notices to give self-represented parties that option; current civil assignment not established.

chambers_communications.summary: Use assistant for scheduling/operational questions; merits filings go to clerk. No direct merits communications to judge.

courtesy_copies.summary: Filed motion accompanies hearing request; separate general courtesy-copy policy not established.

facts.summary: County criminal assignment; email scheduling and portal/email Word orders. Civil instructions and differing assistant-email domains remain qualified source evidence.

review_scope.collected: Official profile HTML/text and linked procedure URLs; reused assignment order.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Contacts, assignment, basic scheduling, order routing and appearances, including retained civil instructions.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Criminal pleas/sentencing substance and linked small-claims litigation procedures; no exhaustive noncivil review.
